about_the_game:
About This Game

Chak Chak is a wholesome adventure game with interactive mini-games inspired by mindfulness traditions. Players guide Chak Chak through a series of chapters, meeting characters, completing challenges, and exploring environments that encourage calm focus and joy.

Gameplay Overview

  • Mindfulness Mini-Games – Breathing, focus, and simple interactive exercises designed to relax and uplift.

  • Chapter-Based Progression – Each chapter introduces new locations, friends, and light challenges.

  • Exploration & Interaction – Discover hidden details in cozy, beautiful worlds.

  • Relaxed Pace – No timers, no stress; play at your own rhythm.

Key Features

  • Single-player, narrative-driven adventure.

  • For all ages, with intuitive and accessible gameplay.

  • Hand-painted visuals and a soothing original soundtrack.

  • Approx. 1 hour of gameplay with replayable mini-games.


    Credits
    This game was brought to life through the creativity and dedication of a wonderful team:

    Game Development by Zeynab Mirzadeh
    Business Development by Hadi Ghasemi Nanesa
    2D Art by Amanda Merrifield
    Original Music & Vocals by Léa Jouffrieau
    3D Art by Shahin Ghasemi Nejad

With deep appreciation for their talent and passion.
